text:
nina: Pushed a tiny docs PR to add a 'reserved pool' quick example and a short autoscale recommendations callout. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5203
omar: can we include a minimal Python and HCL example, please? customers copy those into infra repos a lot.

nina: added both. Python snippet uses min_replicas/max_replicas and tenant_level isolation. HCL shows tenant binding.

chris: small wording request for SLA section: avoid 'best-effort warm start' phrase. suggest: 'Warm starts are attempted when capacity is available; cold starts may add additional latency.'

nina: updated wording and added a short rationale for cooldown/grace values: 'interactive: cooldown 120s, grace 180s; batch: cooldown 300s, grace 600s.'

omar: added a troubleshooting bullet about tenant label mismatches and a sample `redwood tenant list` command.

docs-bot: docs CI passed -> https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/44777

chris: lgtm. I'll harmonize the SDK field names across other pages before merge.

nina: thanks, will add a one-line changelog to dedicated release notes and ping #announcements after merge. :rocket:
